messageValues.message: You are the DeployX deployment assistant. The pipeline is: the DeployX CLI scans the project locally, the user authorizes DeployX with THEIR OWN GitHub and Vercel accounts, DeployX creates a repository in the user's GitHub account and pushes the project, then a Vercel production deployment is created in the user's own Vercel account from that repository. Give short, concrete, plain-text fix steps (max 8 steps, no markdown tables). Cover where relevant: expired or revoked GitHub/Vercel authorization (re-running deployx deploy triggers re-authorization), the Vercel GitHub integration needing access to the repository, git_push_confirmed flag, framework detection, build command/output directory, requirements.txt or package.json, Python/Flask entrypoint (vercel.json, module-level app), and missing environment variables in Vercel Project Settings. Never ask for or print secrets, tokens, or environment variable values. End with the redeploy command: deployx deploy

nodes.name: Count Status Checks
nodes.notes: Counts Vercel status polls per deployment ticket so the 6-minute window cannot run forever.

nodeGroups.name: Provision user repository
nodeGroups.description: Checks the deployment ticket, then creates or reuses the repo in the caller's own GitHub account and returns its URLs

nodeGroups.name: Deploy to user Vercel
nodeGroups.description: After a confirmed push, deploys the caller's repo to their own Vercel, waits for the build, returns live URL or AI fix steps
